messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Turner <emma.turner@synthai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Pricing and committed discount follow-up

Hi Emma,

Thanks for the call this morning — great to learn more about SynthAI's productization plan. Quick recap + proposed next steps on pricing/commitment based on the traffic estimates you shared.

Recap of usage (from your notes):
- Real-time chat + generation: ~5M tokens/day (peak 8M) -> ~150M tokens/month (avg)
- Batch embeddings/analytics: ~20M tokens/month
- Expected growth: 30-50% over next 6 months

Target unit economics you mentioned on the call: aim for ~$10 / 1M tokens (blended) with committed-use.

Redwood preliminary proposal (subject to legal/finance review):
- Hosted API list price: $25 / 1M tokens
- Startup program: 50% off list for first 3 months (eligibility confirmed)
- Committed use (12-month term):
  - Tier A: 50M tokens/month commit -> $12 / 1M
  - Tier B: 100M tokens/month commit -> $9 / 1M
  - Tier C: 200M tokens/month commit -> $7.5 / 1M
- Multi-year incentive: additional 10% off on a 24-month commitment (applies to committed price)

Example blended math (based on 150M/month):
- If you commit 100M/month @ $9/1M + startup credit first 3 months, blended avg in year-1 would be ~ $8-9 / 1M depending on cache hit and embedding ratios.

Next steps:
1) I attached a draft_pricing_proposal.pdf with the above tiers and an estimate table — please review.
2) Can you confirm the expected % of inference tokens that are cache hits (this materially changes billed tokens)?
3) If the 100M/month commit looks reasonable, I can loop in Finance and Legal for a draft SOW/DocuSign.

Open to a quick 30-min follow-up tomorrow to lock numbers — what time works?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199

Attachments: draft_pricing_proposal.pdf

From: Emma Turner <emma.turner@synthai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Pricing and committed discount follow-up

Thanks Marissa — that recap is helpful. A few quick clarifications: 

- Our product currently averages ~60% cache hit on prompt prefixes for chat; that should improve as we warm caches but assume 50-60% for Q1. Does Redwood bill on tokens after cache (i.e., billed tokens = generated + uncached prompt)?
- The $9 / 1M at 100M commit is in the right ballpark; can you confirm whether embeddings are priced separately or included in the blended rate?
- On internal budget timing: we have a line item of ~$450k/yr earmarked for model infra right now. If we do a 12-month commit at 100M/mo @ $9/1M we land at ~$1.08M/yr pre-startup credits — that's beyond the current allocation unless we spread it across product and infra. Would you be able to structure a ramp (e.g., 6-month ramp commit) or provide a multi-year structure to smooth spend?

Also can you share the SOW/contract lead time and any standard exit/flex clauses (e.g., allow downscale of commit after a quarter with penalty)?

Happy to jump on a call tomorrow at 10am PT if that works — thanks for moving quickly.

—Emma
Emma Turner
Head of Product
SynthAI, Inc
emma.turner@synthai.com

Ben/Laura,

Quick internal — SynthAI (Emma Turner) is interested in a committed-use agreement but budgeted only ~$450k/yr today. They estimated ~150M tokens/month which puts a 100M/mo commit @ $9/1M at ~ $1.08M/yr (pre-credits). I proposed: startup program 50% off for first 3 months + a 12-month commit at $9/1M for 100M/mo with a 24-month option that adds 10% off the committed price.

Proposal asks for internal approval:
- Approve offering Tier B: 100M/mo @ $9 / 1M for 12 months (subject to SOW/legal)
- Approve applying Startup program 50% off for first 3 months
- Approve optional 24-month term with additional 10% off (if customer commits up front)
- Consider allowing a 6-month ramp (commit starts at 60% of target for first 6 months) to accommodate their budget constraints — we can treat ramp as a contract addendum.

Why this is reasonable: 100M/mo gets them near the target $/1M they asked for and we stay within predictable capacity planning. Offering a ramp + startup credits should de-risk procurement and increase chances of landing the committed deal.

If you can approve the 12-month @ $9/1M + startup credit I will send the draft SOW and DocuSign link. If we need to tighten the discount, suggest moving 24-month only or require finance sign-off for >30% effective discount.

Thanks — can you reply with quick +1 or changes?

Marissa

Hi Emma — following up after our internal alignment. Appreciate the budget context; below is an updated, optional structure to hit your $450k/yr target while giving a path to scale.

Option A — Short ramp (12-month commitment, ramped billing):
- 12-month term, commitment target: 100M tokens/month
- Ramp: months 1-3 = 40% of commit, months 4-6 = 70% of commit, months 7-12 = 100%
- Committed price (applies once full commit reached): $9 / 1M tokens
- Startup program: 50% off list for first 3 months (applies to usage billed during ramp)
- Estimated year-1 spend (with ramp + startup credits): ~ $540k — assumes 60% cache hit and 20M embeddings/month (detailed table in attached pdf)

Option B — Multi-year smoothing (preferred if you can stretch procurement):
- 24-month term, commit 60M tokens/month (lower monthly cap) -> effective committed price: $8.1 / 1M (10% off $9)
- Year-1 estimated spend: ~ $430-480k depending on cache hit
- Includes startup program first 3 months credit

Key notes:
- Embeddings: billed separately per API type; in our attached draft I included an embeddings line item — embeddings typically add ~5-15% to total tokens depending on your workflow.
- Billed tokens = generated tokens + uncached prompt tokens (we do not bill duplicate cached responses). I will get formal wording from Finance/Legal on cache treatment in the SOW.
- Standard exit/flex clauses: we can include a one-time downscale clause after Q1 with a pro-rated termination/true-up. Legal will propose specific language.

Next steps: if either option looks viable, I will send a draft SOW and DocuSign. I can also propose a payment schedule to align with your budget (quarterly invoicing / net-30).

Would you like me to share the DocuSign link now or after you confirm option A vs B? Happy to jump on the 10am call to run through the numbers.

Thanks,
